item.title: Bladen school board to hold public hearing on possible East Arcadia closure
item.description: The Bladen County Board of Education will hold a third public hearing Monday regarding the potential closure of East Arcadia School and its consolidation with Clarkton School of Discovery.

item.title: Wilmington man sentenced to up to 19.9 years in fatal 2023 stabbing
item.description: A Wilmington man will spend nearly 20 years in prison after pleading guilty Monday to second-degree murder in a 2023 fatal stabbing.

item.title: NC Azalea Festival names new executive director
item.description: The North Carolina Azalea Festival has named Melissa Lasarsky as its new executive director.

item.title: Jury begins deliberations in Pender County Clerk Elizabeth Craver’s trail
item.description: The jury is now in deliberations in the trial of Elizabeth Craver.

item.title: Severe weather preparedness week kicks off across North Carolina as spring-like temperatures arrive
item.description: It's severe weather preparedness week across North Carolina.

item.title: UPDATE – SAFELY FOUND – Brunswick County Sheriff’s Office searches for missing woman
item.description: The Brunswick County Sheriff's Office is asking for the public's assistance in finding a missing 89-year-old women, Marcia Yarbrough Craig.

item.title: NC man indicted on Murder and Death by Vehicle charges
item.description: A North Carolina man has been indicted on second-degree murder and death by vehicle charges.

item.title: Two Columbus County women arrested on child endangerment charges
item.description: The Columbus County Sheriff's Office has arrested two people on child endangerment charges. Lynn Richardson, and Katelynn Richardson, identified as primary caregivers, have been arrested.

item.title: South Brunswick knocks off Hoggard 9-4
item.description: In a battle of former conference rivals, South Brunswick softball picked up a road win over Hoggard 9-4 on Monday.

item.title: Pender County Commissioners votes against resolutions for new district maps, change to district voting
item.description: Commissioner Brent Springer's motion to approve the resolution to redistrict, or redraw the county's five districts, did not receive a second, which means Springer's motion died.
